title: Designer Workspace Anatomy & Persona Switching
subtitle: Unlocking the Tri-Persona Architecture: Vector, Pixel & Export Workspaces

learningObjectives: Understand the conceptual separation and seamless cohesion between Vector Persona, Pixel Persona, and Export Persona.
Navigate the Affinity Designer top Toolbar, Persona Switcher, Context Toolbar, Tools Panel, and Dockable Studios.
Switch between personas without leaving the current document, preserving layer hierarchy and object states.
Customize workspace Studio layouts and save optimized presets for vector illustration vs raster shading.
standardSections.foundationalKnowledge: Unlike legacy vector applications that treat vector geometry and raster pixel painting as completely isolated software silos, Affinity Designer integrates an ultra-fast dual-engine core. In Designer, vector and raster layers coexist inside a unified scene graph. Personas are not separate file modes; they are specialized modal toolsets tailored for distinct creative phases: (1) Vector Persona provides infinite resolution bezier precision, boolean curves, and typography; (2) Pixel Persona brings raster brushes, textured shading, eraser tools, and selection marquees; (3) Export Persona delivers production-grade multi-format asset slicing and batch export.

technicalEvidence.source: Official Affinity Designer 3.3.3 Interface & Persona Architecture Documentation

shortcut.win: Click Persona icons (Top-Left Toolbar) / Custom shortcut in Settings > Shortcuts (e.g. Alt+D, Alt+P, Alt+E). Note: Ctrl+1 is Zoom 100%
shortcut.mac: Click Persona icons (Top-Left Toolbar) / Custom shortcut in Settings > Shortcuts (e.g. Opt+D, Opt+P, Opt+E). Note: Cmd+1 is Zoom 100%

toolAndFeatureExplanation.description: The Persona Switcher sits in the top-left corner of the main toolbar. Clicking an icon instantly swivels the left Tools Panel and right Studio panels to expose persona-specific capabilities while leaving the active artwork completely intact.
contextBarOptions: Vector Persona: Node selection, Pen mode, Boolean operations, Convert to Curves, Fill/Stroke swatches
Pixel Persona: Brush dynamics, Flow/Opacity sliders, Blend modes, Symmetry mode, Protect Alpha toggle
Export Persona: Slice Tool, Slice Selection Tool, Export Options panel, Slices batch list

stepByStepInstructions.title: Inspect the Vector Persona Default Workspace
stepByStepInstructions.instruction: Launch Affinity Designer and open any vector artboard. Notice the top toolbar displaying the blue Pen icon (Vector Persona active). On the left, observe the vector toolset: Move Tool (V), Node Tool (A), Pen Tool (P), and Shape tools.

stepByStepInstructions.title: Switch to Pixel Persona for Raster Embellishment
stepByStepInstructions.instruction: Click the raster brush icon on the top-left Persona toolbar (or use a custom shortcut if configured). Notice the left toolbar instantly transform to display the Paint Brush Tool (B), Pixel Tool, Eraser Brush Tool (E), and Selection Marquees.

stepByStepInstructions.title: Switch to Export Persona for Slice Extraction
stepByStepInstructions.instruction: Click the Export Persona icon on the top-left Persona toolbar. The canvas switches to slice-generation mode, displaying the Slice Tool (S) on the left and the Slices panel on the right, displaying all defined asset bounding boxes.

stepByStepInstructions.title: Reset and Organize Studio Panels
stepByStepInstructions.instruction: Return to Vector Persona by clicking the Designer Persona icon. Go to Window > Studio > Reset Studio if panels have become disorganized, or toggle Studio visibility using Tab to focus purely on the canvas.

guidedPractice.title: Hands-On Tri-Persona Walkthrough
guidedPractice.taskDescription: Create a vector circle, switch to Pixel Persona to paint a textured shadow clipped inside the circle, and switch to Export Persona to define a slice.
checkpoints: Draw an ellipse using the Ellipse Tool (M) with a vibrant teal fill (#00d2ff).
Switch to Pixel Persona (Ctrl+2 / Cmd+2). Select the Paint Brush Tool (B) and pick a dark charcoal color.
Paint across the lower half of the circle. Notice how the pixel stroke automatically nests as a child mask inside the vector shape.
Switch to Export Persona (Ctrl+3 / Cmd+3) and verify that the circle slice appears in the Slices panel.
guidedPractice.expectedOutcome: A vector circle containing organic raster texture, completely editable in vector without rasterizing the underlying bezier geometry.

independentChallenge.title: Multi-Persona Icon Construction
independentChallenge.prompt: Construct a clean vector app icon (1024x1024 px) in Vector Persona. In Pixel Persona, add hand-stippled highlight and shadow layers using a textured brush. In Export Persona, configure 1x, 2x, and 3x PNG export presets.
challengeCriteria: Base icon geometry must remain 100% scalable vector paths.
All raster shading must be clipped inside vector parent layers.
Export Persona must have 3 automated output scales (1x, 2x, 3x) configured for the icon slice.
independentChallenge.bonusGoal: Assign unique color tags to the vector vs pixel layers in the Layers Studio.

commonPitfalls.pitfall: Mistaking Vector Brush for Pixel Brush
commonPitfalls.cause: In Vector Persona, the Vector Brush Tool (B) draws a vector bezier path textured with a bitmap nozzle. In Pixel Persona, the Paint Brush Tool (B) draws raw raster pixels into a pixel layer.
commonPitfalls.solution: Always check your active Persona icon before painting. For scalable paths, stay in Vector Persona; for hand-drawn grain or photorealistic shading, switch to Pixel Persona.

commonPitfalls.pitfall: Accidentally rasterizing vector layers when painting
commonPitfalls.cause: Painting with a pixel brush over an unmasked vector shape can prompt Designer to rasterize the entire vector layer if 'Insert Inside' is not enabled.
commonPitfalls.solution: Create a dedicated Pixel Layer as a child clip of the vector shape, or ensure the 'Insert inside the selection' toggle is active on the top toolbar.

commonPitfalls.cause: Accidentally pressing Tab hides all studio panels and toolbars for distraction-free canvas preview.
commonPitfalls.solution: Press Tab again, or go to Window > Studio > Reset Studio to restore default layout.

knowledgeCheck.question: What is the primary architectural advantage of Personas in Affinity Designer compared to opening separate vector and raster applications?
options: Personas automatically convert all vector artwork into 300 DPI bitmaps.
Personas allow vector and pixel operations to coexist non-destructively within the exact same document without file export or conversion.
Personas reduce file size by disabling the undo history.
Personas require three separate user licenses.
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Affinity Designer shares a single unified core engine. Switching personas immediately changes the active toolset while keeping the document, vector mathematics, raster layers, and undo stack intact.

knowledgeCheck.question: By default out-of-the-box in Affinity Designer, how do you switch between Personas?
options: Press Ctrl+1, Ctrl+2, or Ctrl+3 (which actually control canvas zoom to 100%, 200%)
Click the Persona Switcher icons on the top-left toolbar, or configure custom shortcuts under Settings > Shortcuts
Restart the application with a command line flag
Export the file to PSD and re-open it
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Affinity Designer does not assign default keyboard shortcuts to switch personas; Ctrl+1 is Zoom 100%. Users click the Persona Switcher icons in the top-left toolbar or assign custom shortcuts in Settings > Keyboard Shortcuts.

knowledgeCheck.question: If you paint with the Paint Brush Tool in Pixel Persona while a vector shape is selected with 'Insert Inside' active, what happens to the painted pixels?
options: The vector shape is permanently flattened into a JPEG.
The pixels are clipped non-destructively inside the vector shape boundaries as a child mask layer.
The stroke disappears because vector shapes cannot hold pixels.
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Affinity Designer nests the pixel layer directly inside the vector curve, creating a non-destructive clipping mask where the vector curve defines the visible boundary.

summaryPoints: Affinity Designer unifies Vector, Pixel, and Export capabilities into a single seamless document model.
Vector Persona provides infinite mathematical precision for branding, logos, and UI layout.
Pixel Persona enables tactile raster texturing, stippling, and photorealistic shading directly on vector artwork.
Export Persona automates modern multi-density asset generation without manual cropping.

slides.title: Affinity Designer Workspace & Tri-Persona Architecture
slides.subtitle: A Paradigm Shift in Digital Design Software
slides.contentMarkdown:
Welcome to **Affinity Designer 3.0**.

Unlike traditional creative workflows that force you to jump between different standalone software for vector drawing and bitmap retouching, Designer is built upon a **unified dual-engine core**.

In this lesson, you will master the **Tri-Persona architecture**: navigating between vector precision, raster texturing, and automated export in a single click.

actionBox.label: Key Insight
actionBox.text: Personas are not file formats; they are specialized tool modes operating on the exact same document.

slides.title: The Tri-Persona Ecosystem Explained
slides.subtitle: Vector, Pixel & Export Workspaces
slides.contentMarkdown:
Affinity Designer organizes your creative workflow into three specialized personas:

1. **Vector Persona (Designer Persona):** Your primary design studio. Precision bezier curves, infinite scaling, typography, boolean geometry, and symbols.
2. **Pixel Persona:** Direct raster manipulation. Textured shading, custom grain brushes, selection marquees, and pixel-level retouching.
3. **Export Persona:** Production export station. Define continuous slices, export 1x/2x/3x assets, and generate SVG/PDF specs in one click.

*Note on Navigation:* By default, switch between Personas by clicking the top-left toolbar switcher. Shortcuts like `Ctrl+1` / `Cmd+1` default to 100% Zoom, though custom shortcuts can be configured in Settings.

visual.content: Vector Persona (Electric Cyan #00d2ff) | Pixel Persona (Cobalt Blue #38bdf8) | Export Persona (Neon Emerald #10b981)

slides.title: Anatomy of the Designer Interface
slides.subtitle: Navigating the 5 Core Workspace Zones
slides.contentMarkdown:
Every element of the Affinity Designer interface has been engineered for maximum creative focus:

- **Top Toolbar:** Home to the Persona Switcher, Document Setup, Snapping toggles, and Geometry buttons.
- **Context Toolbar:** Dynamically updates to display modifiers and settings for your currently active tool.
- **Left Tools Panel:** Houses primary tool icons (Move, Node, Pen, Shapes, Brushes).
- **Right Studio Panels:** Dockable inspectors for Layers, Color, Swatches, Stroke, Appearance, and Transform.
- **Canvas Viewport:** Ultra-smooth 60fps pan/zoom hardware-accelerated rendering stage.

actionBox.label: Pro Shortcut
actionBox.text: Press Tab at any time to instantly hide all toolbars and studio panels for distraction-free full canvas viewing.

slides.title: Hands-On Step-by-Step Persona Switching
slides.subtitle: Execute the Multi-Persona Workflow
slides.contentMarkdown:
Follow these steps to experience seamless persona switching:

1. **Vector Stage:** Press `M` to activate the Ellipse Tool. Click and drag on the canvas while holding `Shift` to create a perfect circle.
2. **Color Fill:** Assign a bright electric cyan fill `#00d2ff` in the Color Studio.
3. **Switch to Pixel Persona:** Click the Pixel Persona icon on the top-left toolbar. Notice your left toolbar transform to raster tools.
4. **Clip Pixel Brush:** Press `B` for the Paint Brush Tool, choose a soft grain brush, and paint across the bottom rim.
5. **Inspect Layers:** Notice the pixel layer is automatically nested inside your vector circle as a child clipping mask!
6. **Export Stage:** Click the Export Persona icon to view your automatically generated export slice in Export Persona.

visual.content: Vector Shape (Infinite Math) + Pixel Texture (Organic Grain) = Unified Masterpiece

slides.title: Common Pitfalls & Troubleshooting
slides.subtitle: Avoid These Beginner Missteps
slides.contentMarkdown:
### 1. Vector Brush vs Pixel Brush Confusion
- **The Issue:** Choosing the Vector Brush Tool (B in Vector Persona) thinking it acts like a Photoshop brush.
- **The Fix:** The Vector Brush produces an editable bezier path with an image nozzle. For true raster painting and grain, switch to Pixel Persona (`Ctrl+2` / `Cmd+2`).

### 2. Accidental Destructive Rasterization
- **The Issue:** Painting on a vector layer without clipping, causing Designer to rasterize the entire shape.
- **The Fix:** Enable 'Insert inside the selection' on the top toolbar or nest a dedicated Pixel Layer as a child in the Layers panel.

### 3. Missing Studio Panels
- **The Fix:** If panels disappear, press `Tab` or navigate to `Window > Studio > Reset Studio`.

actionBox.label: Golden Rule
actionBox.text: Never rasterize a vector shape just to shade it. Nest a pixel layer inside the vector parent instead.

slides.title: Independent Challenge: Tri-Persona App Icon
slides.subtitle: Put Your Knowledge into Practice
slides.contentMarkdown:
### Your Mission:
Construct a clean vector app icon (1024x1024 px) in Vector Persona.

1. In **Vector Persona**, draw base geometric shapes using the Ellipse and Rectangle tools.
2. In **Pixel Persona**, add subtle hand-stippled highlight and shadow layers using a textured brush nested inside the shapes.
3. In **Export Persona**, configure 1x, 2x, and 3x PNG export presets in the Slices studio.

### Acceptance Criteria:
- Base geometry remains 100% vector curves.
- Raster shading is clipped non-destructively.
- Slices panel shows automated 1x, 2x, 3x configurations.
